name: Awei TP100 Enc Hi-Fidelity Sound with Digital Screen Tws Earbuds (  6month Official Warranty )
description:
Awei TP100 ENC Touch Screen Earbuds | Hi-Fidelity Sound & Smart Controls | TWS Wireless Earphones

Upgrade your listening experience with the Awei TP100 ENC Earbuds, combining Hi-Fi sound, adaptive ENC noise reduction, and touch screen smart controls. Perfect for music lovers, gamers, and busy professionals, these earbuds deliver clear calls, immersive audio, and all-day convenience.

🔑 Key Features

Touch Screen Smart Controls: Intuitive control for music playback, calls, and voice assistant with just a tap.

ENC Noise Reduction: Environmental Noise Cancellation ensures crystal-clear calls even in noisy environments.

Hi-Fidelity Sound: 35mAh earbuds deliver clear highs, rich mids, and deep bass for immersive listening.

Bluetooth 5.4: Stable, low-latency wireless connection for smooth audio streaming.

Battery & Playtime:

Earbuds: 35mAh each, 1-hour charging time

Charging Case: 500mAh, providing up to 20 hours total use

Music Playback: 6 hours

Talk Time: 4 hours

Standby Time: 300 hours

Compact & Portable: Sleek design fits comfortably in your ears and pockets.

Wireless Convenience: TWS (True Wireless Stereo) for seamless, cable-free listening.

📦 Package Includes

1 × Pair of Awei TP100 ENC Earbuds

1 × Charging Case (500mAh)

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
